title: OpenGDD v0.9 tuning
$comment: Cross-field rules stay validator-level: a key appears in values or open, never both; every ranges key MUST exist in values or open; each minimum MUST NOT exceed its maximum; each authored value or guess MUST lie inside its own range; and every rule MUST parse and be checked over the package-decided numbers and available guesses.

values.description: Required flat map of dotted keys to finite JSON numbers.

open.description: Optional flat map of open numbers to a finite numeric guess, or null for no guess.

ranges.description: Optional inclusive [minimum, maximum] bounds for a values or open key.

rules.description: Optional named one-line rules over tuning numbers and top-level numeric record fields.

tuningKey.$comment: Reserved first and extension segments are validator-level because the reserved list is versioned.
tuningKey.description: A flat dotted key with at least two segments; at least one segment contains a character other than a digit.
